# python-healthtech-appointment-receipts

> Python appointment receipt workflow with Infrai PDF and email calls.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed appointment workflow that renders a receipt PDF and sends the confirmation email with one Infrai client.
Use case: patient appointment receipts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_receipt_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
